scope: Chrome runs actual JEditor/NewsModal/NewsDetail in a minimal preview shell connected to synthetic local Spring/MySQL/Redis. api/manage is replaced by a real Axios wrapper and dictionary controls are stubbed. Qiniu responses, network failures/delays, deferred uploadMedia race responses, and historical attack HTML injected through component state are simulated. Video uses synthetic uploaded bytes and verifies node insertion, not playback. No production access.
